page.layout: One printed page. Top: an ornamental border, then the title block (three lines and a subtitle, centred). Below: two columns of index entries, left and right. Below the right column: a single letter Y. No margin notes.

main_text.head: COLLECTIO VERBO-RUM IUXTA ORDINEM Alphabeti ex Tit.Digestorum de ver-borum significatione per P. C. B.

page.notes: Greek headwords are doubtful: the first Greek entry (after Accipere) is largely illegible; the entries after "Ante & post" and after "Apostoli", and the first entry in the right column after "Aut", are read with [?]. Several page references (e.g. Abrogare l.102, Boues l.8.) are read from small type and may be misread. Long s has been normalised to s. The letter Y below the right column is taken as the gathering signature. A dot at the lower right is a printer's mark or stain and is not transcribed.
